claim: Amazon's Q2 2026 revenue grew 19.6% from a year earlier.
summary: Claim concerns Amazon Q2 2026 (April-June 2026) YoY revenue growth of 19.6%. With no tools and a knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 that precedes the Q2 2026 reporting period, the growth rate cannot be verified from existing knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Amazon's Q2 2026 revenue was 19.6% higher than its Q2 2025 revenue
sub_claims.note: No browsing or data tools available and knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 is before Q2 2026 ended and was reported (typically late July 2026); no evidence to confirm or contradict the 19.6% figure.
